description: Retrieves a specific membership on a Trello board by its ID.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idMembership.description: The ID of the membership to retrieve.
idMembership.title: Id Membership

member.description: Set to 'true' to return the full member object. If 'false' or not provided, Trello's default for member details (typically minimal) applies.
member.title: Member

member_fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return when 'member' is 'true' (e.g., 'avatarHash,fullName'), or 'all' for all fields. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username. Defaults to API behavior if not specified.
member_fields.title: Member Fields

idMember.description: The member's ID associated with this membership

memberType.description: The member's role on the board (e.g., 'admin', 'normal')
memberType.title: Member Type

unconfirmed.description: Whether the membership invitation is pending confirmation
